scope: Coordinated task goals; finite, public regression corpus, not general intelligence

cases.input: Act as a tutor that teaches recursion and explains stack frames. Never expose student names.
Build an assistant that summarizes tickets and identifies repeated incidents. Return only JSON.
I need an analyst that compares revenue and calculates margins and flags missing records. Never invent data.
Create an editor that checks spelling and preserves quotations. Keep client.secret unchanged.
Act as an engineer who reviews migrations and estimates downtime. Do not change account_id.
I need a librarian who indexes Telugu titles and locates English translations. Never upload documents.
Build a coach who checks practice logs and suggests recovery sessions and tracks workload. Return only JSON.
Serve as a planner who schedules deliveries and balances driver workloads and keeps depot coverage. Never disclose customer addresses.
Build a tool which checks Arabic labels and maps duplicate identifiers. Never alter the original labels.
Create an assistant which explains tradeoffs and lists open questions and estimates effort. Do not fabricate sources.
I need a system which sorts applications and counts missing attachments. Always preserve application IDs.
Act as a guide which describes temples and compares access routes and explains local customs. Never request passport numbers.
Build an assistant that summarizes tickets and respond in Telugu. Never disclose names.
Create a tool who checks records and preserve account_id unchanged. Never remove logs.
Build a tool which compares revenue and include a chart. Never disclose names.
